surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions involve the interaction of the iron precursor [Fe(ipki)2] with water, leading to the formation of iron oxide layers. The process is water-assisted and self-limiting, with the precursor reacting with surface hydroxyl groups and subsequent water pulses regenerating the hydroxyl sites.
evidence: The surface reactions are described as water-assisted and self-limiting, with the precursor reacting with surface hydroxyl groups and subsequent water pulses regenerating the hydroxyl sites. The text mentions the use of water as a co-reactant in the ALD process and the formation of iron oxide layers through these interactions.
